title: Optimize D3 Diagram Drag Performance With Benchmark
description: Optimize the D3 force diagram and design diagram drag performance in compose/sketchpad/index.tsx for real-time smooth behavior. The drag is currently laggy due to: (1) simulation tick calling setDiagramNodes on every tick causing React re-renders at 60fps, (2) DRAG_THROTTLE_MS=50 (20fps) in design diagram onNodeDrag, (3) updateNodesFromSimulation creating new node arrays on every tick. Fix by: batching simulation ticks via requestAnimationFrame, removing the 50ms throttle and using RAF instead, and adding a Playwright benchmark test in index.tsx that measures drag frame time and asserts it stays under 16ms (60fps).
